identity.mission: Create a futuristic, high-tech crypto investment platform with a 'BitNest' aesthetic.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Cyberpunk neon with Swiss precision.
Emotion First: Evoke trust, wealth, and technological superiority.
Content is King: Data visualization is the hero.
Zoom In: Focus on the numbers and the gains.
Negative Space: Use deep black space to make neon pop.
Contrast: High contrast is mandatory for readability in dark mode.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-400 to-green-400 text-black font-bold hover:opacity-90 transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,255,136,0.4)]

cards.default: bg-[#111111] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-green-400/50 transition-all duration-300
cards.highlight: bg-[#111111] border border-green-400/50 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,255,136,0.15)]

inputs.default: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-green-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-400 transition-all placeholder:text-gray-600

visual_enhancers.background_pattern: Wavy flowing lines (SVG) in background with low opacity (5%)
visual_enhancers.card_pattern: Triangle geometric pattern overlay on cards (CSS background-image)
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow and box-shadow with neon colors for key elements
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React icons with custom colors (Green/Teal)
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts with custom tooltips and neon strokes

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Add the custom colors (neon-green, neon-teal, gold, deep-black) to `tailwind.config.js`.
2. GLOBAL CSS: Update `index.css` to set the default background to `#050505` and text to `#FFFFFF`. Add a global class for the 'wavy background' pattern.
3. FONTS: Import 'Outfit' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in `index.css`.
4. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components (Button, Card, Input) to match the 'BitNest' style (remove default radius if needed, add glowing borders).
5. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' for the Dashboard. Create a layout wrapper that includes the Sidebar and Topbar.
6. PAGES: Implement the pages in this order: Home (Landing), Auth (Login/Register), Dashboard, Wallet, Invest.
7. CHARTS: Use Recharts for the 'Live Crypto Trading Charts'. Style them with neon strokes and dark backgrounds.
8. ANIMATIONS: Add subtle entrance animations (fade-in-up) for all cards using Framer Motion or CSS keyframes.
9. TESTING: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a large heading.
Keep the UI 'clean' but 'rich' with subtle details like borders and shadows.
